en: Color postcard with a central photograph bordered by a white margin. The photo shows a busy outdoor market street crowded with people, lined with flowering trees and stalls. In the background are historic towers and church spires, alongside modern commercial buildings with a prominent vertical rainbow-colored sign for the C&A store. At the bottom margin of the postcard, the word 'NIJMEGEN' is printed.
